defects.description: Jupyter automatically injects -f <kernel_connection_file>, causing strict argparse.parse_args() to fail with unrecognized arguments.
defects.action: Implemented parse_known_args() to isolate and log Jupyter kernel arguments while strictly rejecting arbitrary unknown flags.

defects.description: Hardcoded local dataset paths in manifest prevent loading from read-only /kaggle/input FUSE mount.
defects.action: Added --data-dir argument and data_root parameter to TrujilloTileDataset, rebasing patch paths to {data_root}/images/Oil/ and {data_root}/masks/Mask_oil/.

defects.description: Unconditionally passing data_root=args.data_dir in train_exp01.py broke mock_dataset_init in unit tests because mock signature lacked **kwargs.
defects.action: Conditioned data_root passing in train_exp01.py and added defensive *args, **kwargs to mock_dataset_init.

defects.description: Argument parser was constructed inside main(), preventing external modular validation and testing.
defects.action: Extracted def build_arg_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser as top-level function.

defects.description: PendingDeprecationWarning on * multiplication operator instead of @ matmul.
defects.action: Upstream third-party package warning. Tracked as non-blocking; does not alter mathematical precision.
